notes: US store banner: Enjoy free standard and in-store shipping for purchases over $45. Free returns within 30 days at Fedex ServicePoints and Camper stores. FAQ 54: 30 days from the date of reception for online orders. Homepage meta: Contemporary designs, original spirit, 2 years warranty.

History page: Antonio Fluxa set up a workshop in Inca, Mallorca in 1877; his grandson Lorenzo creates Camper in 1975; To this day, Camper is a family business; headquarters in Inca, central Mallorca. Timeline: 1975 Camaleón (first shoe, unisex), 1988 Twins, 1995 Pelotas, 2004 Peu.

Twins page: In 1988 TWINS was born, a concept where the right is different from the left, subtly mismatched but perfectly compatible. Pelotas page: Our Icon Since 1995. Menu OUR ICONS: Pelotas, Peu, Twins (basis for known_for).
